verdict.rationale: Brave ships a ready-made agent tool: an official MCP server exposing web, local, image, video, news, LLM-context and summarizer tools, plus first-party guides for Claude Desktop, Dify, n8n, OpenClaw and Open WebUI, and Skills for many coding agents. The 'function-calling schemas' part is only implied through the MCP tool definitions, and no OpenAPI spec was found, so coverage is partial. Missing for 10: explicitly documented function-calling JSON schemas (OpenAI/Anthropic-style tool definitions), a published OpenAPI spec (probe returned 404), integrations with code-level agent frameworks such as LangChain or LlamaIndex, and independent hands-on corroboration of the tool integrations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug the API into an agent as a ready-made tool, with function-calling schemas and agent-framework integrations designed for direct tool-call consumption

citations.quote: An MCP server implementation that integrates the Brave Search API, providing comprehensive search capabilities including web search, local business search, place search, image search, video search, news search, LLM context, and AI-powered summarization.
This guide covers the steps required to enable Brave Search as a tool to be used in the Claude desktop app using the Model Context Protocol (MCP).
offer real-time, accurate search results as part of AI agent orchestration
Skills work with Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Codex, Gemini CLI, VS Code, Windsurf, OpenClaw, Cline, Goose, Amp, Roo Code
This is the default for RAG, tools, and chatbots.
